about.name: TunePeerly
about.summary: Plays the music on this computer and shares it with the devices you pair. Songs play from the original files.
about.licenseHelp: You can use, share, and modify this app. If other people use a modified version over a network, its source code must be offered under the same license.
about.sourceNote: The complete source code is in this repository.
about.author: Author
about.privacyHelp: There is no account. Your library, playlists, listening history, and pairing details stay on your own devices. Away from your local network, that data is sent through a relay server you configure, which only forwards it to your other devices. Devices talk over TLS 1.3 and accept only the keys saved when pairing, so the relay cannot read it. Pairing uses a one-time 6-digit code. The library database on this computer is encrypted, and on Windows its key opens only under your Windows account.
about.componentsHelp: Tauri, Rust, and React, along with other open-source components. Each of those projects keeps its own license.
about.creditsModify: A modified version may name its own author and redesign this screen. It must keep the original-work notice and state that it is a modified version based on work by zhebuilds.
